prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Korean woman, a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 40s silver fox goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, silver-white sleek straight hair falling past her shoulders — full body applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A light dusting of soot sits on her cheek and chin, with a little dirt on her hands and bare feet. Her expression is a quiet, serious expression. Restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ankle fetter joined by its own short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, to one single huge black iron ring held low between her feet, so that the two ankle chains run from her two ankles and meet at that one ring. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hangs straight down the front of her body and is joined to that same ring between her feet, so that the neck chain and both ankle chains all meet at that one ring, the long chain hanging in a gentle slack curve. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her feet a hand's width apart, her arms relaxed at her sides, the long chain hanging down the center of her body to the ring between her feet in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long coffin matte nails emerald gold tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
